info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fitness Memberships Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Fitness Membership Status API allows users to retrieve the current status of various fitness memberships. This endpoint provides a comprehensive list of membership statuses, enabling fitness center operators and administrators to manage and track membership renewals and expirations efficiently. Typical consumers include gym managers and fitness service providers who need insights into membership trends. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance decision-making processes related to membership offerings and customer engagement.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of memberships.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of memberships associated with a user. It provides details on active, expired, or pending memberships, enabling users to manage their subscriptions effectively.
